gameplay.title: The after-hours ledger
gameplay.briefing: A ledger disappeared from a fictional trading office. Ask Casey Vale about the evening, compare the available records, and identify the specific false claim.

statements.quote: I left at six and did not return to the building that evening.

exhibits.title: Visitor record · 18:42
exhibits.text: The desk visitor record has a signed entry: Casey Vale, arrival 18:42, that same evening.

exhibits.title: Badge record · 19:10
exhibits.text: A badge assigned to Morgan Reed opened the stairwell at 19:10. This record does not name Casey Vale.

clues.text: The statement says there was no return after six, but the visitor record names Casey arriving at 18:42. These accounts conflict about returning to the building.

win.confession: You’re right. I said I left at six and never came back, but I returned to the building at 18:42. I tried to dismiss the signed visitor record because I didn’t want to admit that. It shows I was there, though it doesn’t prove I took the ledger.
win.explanation: Casey’s claim that they left at six and did not return conflicts with the visitor record showing Casey arrived at 18:42.
